prompt: photorealistic studio portrait of an expressive person, 85mm lens, natural lighting

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Generator (ConvTranspose2d) vs Discriminator (Conv2d). Feed-forward latent mapping.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: Denoising U-Net / DiT with cross-attention and time-embedding conditioning.
architectural_comparison.advantage: Diffusion (captures long-range dependencies & semantic context via self/cross-attention)

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Single forward pass (1 step): x = G(z). Deterministic or stochastic.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: Iterative Langevin / reverse SDE denoising over T timesteps (e.g. 20-50 steps, or 1-4 for distilled models).
architectural_comparison.advantage: DCGAN for speed (1-step), Diffusion for progressive quality & controllability

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Adversarial Minimax Loss: min_G max_D E[log D(x)] + E[log(1 - D(G(z)))]. High risk of mode collapse & non-convergence.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: Score Matching / Denoising MSE: E_{t,x0,eps}[||eps - eps_theta(x_t, t)||^2]. Well-behaved, convex, monotonic convergence.
architectural_comparison.advantage: Diffusion (zero mode collapse, stable log-likelihood surrogate)

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Typically limited to 64x64 or 128x128. Struggles with high-frequency textures, symmetry, and fine hands/faces.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: State-of-the-art 512x512 / 1024x1024 photorealism with intricate photorealistic micro-details.

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Prone to mode dropping; discriminator rejects rare modes. Truncation trick needed.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: Full mode coverage covering the empirical distribution support. High entropy diversity.
architectural_comparison.advantage: Diffusion (reproduces entire distribution without dropping modes)

architectural_comparison.dcgan: Coarse condition concatenation. Struggles with spatial composition and prompt adherence.
architectural_comparison.diffusion: Classifier-Free Guidance (CFG) dynamically balances fidelity vs creativity; text embeddings via CLIP/T5 cross-attention.
architectural_comparison.advantage: Diffusion (superior prompt adherence via CFG & cross-attention)
